name: Grab A Kit & Create: Date Night
label: Hands-on workshop
description:
Skip the usual date night and make something instead!
Join us in Foster Art's new adult creative space during their monthly Kids Night Out and spend some time making something together. Choose one of our Meant for 2 kits, grab any additional supplies needed , and settle in for a relaxed, hands-on creative experience.
Enjoy the simple fun of making something together.
Grab a kit. Create together. Make a night of it.
